podcast.title: One recording. Content for every platform.
podcast.description: {company} started with podcasts, and podcasts are still what we know best. We plan, record and edit, so your team only has to show up and talk. One session gives you a full episode plus short clips for every channel you post on.

items.title: End-to-end Production
items.description: We plan the format, run the shoot and deliver the files for interview, educational, promotional and creator-led podcasts.

items.title: Video Podcast
items.description: Your podcast filmed as video, colour graded and subtitled, so it works on YouTube and social feeds as well as audio apps.

items.title: Multi-camera Recording
items.description: 2 to 5 cameras, so every speaker gets a clean angle and every short clip has a clean cut.

items.title: Editing

items.title: Shorts/Reels

items.title: Livestream Podcast

foxdusk.name: Foxdusk
foxdusk.title: Blank page to finished Reel, on your own computer.
foxdusk.description: We built two apps from our own podcast and video production work. Hookdusk AIOS plans your TikTok, Reels and Shorts: scored topics, hooks and a timed script ready to film, in BM or English. Foxdusk AIOS turns your raw recording into a finished video on your Mac or Windows computer, with dead air removed, retakes flagged for your approval, branded captions and motion graphics.
